The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:

"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Honble Court may graciously be pleased to quash the FIR bearing No. 0746/2021 U/S 354/354A/376/506/34 of IPC dated 06.10.2021 registered at P.S. Dwarka North, Delhi and its subsequent proceedings in the interest and furtherance of justice.
Any other order or relief that this Honble Court may be pleased to pass in favour of the Petitioners in the interest and furtherance of justice."

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 is the brother of sister-in-law of respondent no. 2 and the present FIR was registered on account of a matrimonial dispute between the brother of respondent no. 2 and his wife.
5. Issue notice.
6. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioners.
In the meantime, the petitioners shall place on record relevant documents in support of the present petition.
